summary: Stuck detector loopholes: a comment edit resets repeated failures; no bound before the first edit
description:
Source: DFMEA 2026-11-04 (F06, RPN 336). Confirmed in `runtime/stuck.py`.

1. **Failures reset on any edit:** `note_diff_state` clears `failures` on any diff change, including a comment or whitespace edit. Edit a comment, rerun the same failing build, repeat: `same_failure_limit` never trips.
2. **No bound before the first edit:** the no-progress check needs `_diff_state is not None`, so before the first edit only the 400-call guard and the time budget bound reading and searching.

**Fix:**

* The diff signature ignores comment-only and whitespace-only changes. Reuse `strip_c_comments` from the ANVIL-44 checker for C files.
* Repeated-failure counting resets only when the change touches code that the failing command builds or tests (at minimum: a non-comment change).
* An explicit exploration budget before the first edit, set per skill (an investigate run is read-only by design and needs its own limit).

**Acceptance:** tests for comment-edit thrash tripping, the exploration limit tripping, and a real fix after a failure still resetting the counter.

comments.body: [devin] PR #92 up: https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/pull/92 — code_signature (strip_c_comments + whitespace collapse) so comment/whitespace edits can't reset the failure counter; new exploration_tool_calls budget (120, ANVIL_EXPLORE_CALLS, per-run override) bounds read-only investigation before the first diff report. 11/11 tests.
